info.title: DHIS2 Core Web API
info.description: REST API documentation for DHIS2 Core Platform health data and tracker systems.

get.summary: Queries and imports aggregate data value sets
get.description: Retrieve and export aggregated health data values matching specific org units, periods, and data set identifiers.

post.summary: Imports bulk data value sets into DHIS2 repository
post.description: Accepts XML or JSON payload of data values for import into the analytics datastore.

get.description: Executes high-performance analytical queries across indicator dimensions, period hierarchies, and spatial boundaries.
Retrieves the organizational tree hierarchy, geographical boundary coordinates, and parent-child administrative relationships.

get.summary: Retrieves clinical health tracker programs and stage rules
get.description: Access configurations of clinical tracker programs, longitudinal stages, validation indicators, and enrollment rule engines.

get.summary: Queries tracked entity patient and case records
get.description: Retrieves individual tracked entity instances, patient demographics, and longitudinal disease surveillance profiles.

get.summary: Single-event anonymous health interventions without enrollment
get.description: Accesses anonymous point-of-service health interventions and lab survey records.

get.summary: Metadata catalog of data elements and domain indicators
get.description: Returns dictionary definitions, data types, category combos, and aggregation operators of all DHIS2 data elements.

get.summary: Returns current authenticated user profile and roles
get.description: Retrieves current user authorities, assigned organisation units, user group memberships, and credentials.
